text.title: Google Analytics 4 Setup Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable GA4 property signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Is a GA4 property being created or reconfigured (data streams, key events, export, consent) for a site the team controls?

conclusion.verdict: no property to configure; pick the conversion-tracking or reporting methodology instead

branch.question: Does the config record the numeric property id and each stream's G- measurement id as separate fields?

conclusion.verdict: record both ids; fix any API call or snippet using the wrong one

branch.question: Which property signal fails on inspection of the config, the snippet and the property admin?

conclusion.verdict: link the export now and set 14-month retention; it does not backfill
push the four v2 consent defaults before gtag config
declare every toggle; one page_view source only
register dimensions with the right scope before sending; track slot usage
mark key events by exact event name with a counting method
add transaction_id, value, currency and items to purchase
reuse the _ga client_id and session_id; keep api_secret server-side
activate the internal filter; exclude payment and auth referrals; set cross-domain list
emit the config artefact; surface ready_for_review=true

text.example: ga4_property_in_scope=true -> property_id_numeric=true, measurement_id_missing=false -> bigquery_linked=true, retention_months=14, consent_default_before_config=true, transaction_id_present=true, client_id_from_cookie=true, payment_domains_excluded=true -> conclusion ref=run-the-checklist
